cases.title: Solutions Engineer (Early Career)
cases.description: Hands-on early-career role building AI agents, automations, full-stack internal applications, APIs, and MCP integrations. The posting says candidates are not expected to know the whole stack and should learn quickly and take on increasing ownership.

cases.title: Junior AI Automation & Systems Developer
cases.description: Junior hands-on builder role developing AI agents, prompts, workflow automations, integrations, internal tools, and cloud-backed systems. Open to students, recent graduates, early-career and self-taught developers. A specific no-code automation platform is preferred but the actual work aligns strongly.

cases.title: Software Engineer 2, Platform
cases.description: Platform software role spanning full-stack engineering, databases, testing, deployment and maintainable code. The resume is directionally relevant, but production EKS, multi-region networking and Prometheus or Alertmanager depth are not clearly evidenced.

cases.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer (FDE), Strategic Accounts
cases.description: Build production integrations and tooling between a voice-AI platform and strategic enterprise customers. Strong technical overlap, but no direct strategic-account delivery or voice, restaurant, payments and customer-data integration experience.

cases.title: Sr Staff Engineer - Applied AI
cases.description: Senior Staff role setting architecture across multiple teams, leading complex cross-functional AI initiatives visible to a technology VP, influencing organizational standards, and mentoring mid-level engineers.

cases.title: Retrofit Solutions Engineer I
cases.description: Aircraft cabin retrofit engineering centered on 2D and 3D design, engineering drawings, modification kits, certification plans, MRO support and subcontractor coordination. Digitalization is incidental rather than the core work.

cases.title: Product Design, Entry-Level (2027 start)
cases.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
cases.description: New-grad product-design role requiring visual and interaction-design fundamentals, user-centered design process, a design portfolio and high-fidelity prototyping. AI is a design tool, not the job's role family.

cases.title: Junior Software Engineer
cases.description: Junior developer role for 0-2 years of experience building, testing and maintaining software with Python, JavaScript, Java or C#, REST APIs, Git and SQL or NoSQL. The technical fit is strong, but the employer is a staffing firm.

cases.title: Software Engineer Intern (Winter 2027)
cases.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
cases.description: Software engineering internship embedded in product, platform, infrastructure or security teams, with full-stack features, distributed systems, developer tooling and performance work. Technical fit may be strong, but internship status lowers default application priority.
